chest_pain.message: Chest pain can be a sign of a serious heart or lung problem.

difficulty_breathing.message: Difficulty breathing can indicate a serious respiratory or cardiac emergency.

severe_bleeding.message: Uncontrolled or heavy bleeding needs immediate medical attention.

loss_of_consciousness.message: Loss of consciousness or fainting can signal a serious underlying condition.

stroke_signs.message: These symptoms can be signs of a stroke, where every minute matters.

stiff_neck_fever.message: A stiff neck together with fever can be a sign of a serious infection such as meningitis.

severe_abdominal_pain.message: Severe, unbearable abdominal pain can indicate a serious condition requiring urgent evaluation.

self_harm.message: What you're going through sounds really hard, and your safety matters. Please reach out to a crisis line or emergency service right away, or go to the nearest hospital. In Ghana, you can contact the Mental Health Authority helpline (0800 678 678, toll-free) or call the national emergency number 112. If you're outside Ghana, please contact your local emergency number or a crisis helpline.
